explanation.body: On its live record it counts 388 book entries, 6 direction top grade, 57 movement top grade, 325 on probation. No study record is on file for this page; what it shows is its current reading, updated on its normal schedule.
explanation.summary: One verdict per name from the forecasters that earned the top grade: Buy, Wait, Avoid, or no call, with no call as the default and the reason shown for anything else.

forecasters.can_route: Yes: it can set an Avoid call.
forecasters.name: Beaten-down stocks that bounce (warning flag)
forecasters.standing: Earned the top grade. 1 top-grade form, counted across every stock and every day.
forecasters.what: Flags a stock whose price is at or below 60% of its highest price of the last 60 trading days and that has still bounced at least 15% in the last 5 trading days. It expects flagged stocks to do worse over the next 20 trading days.

forecasters.can_route: Yes: it can set an Avoid call.
forecasters.name: Sudden pumps on heavy volume (warning flag)
forecasters.standing: Earned the top grade. 2 top-grade forms: one counted across every stock and every day, and one for calm days and names in the third fifth of trading activity.
forecasters.what: Flags a stock that is up at least 30% in the last 5 trading days on at least 3 times its usual trading volume. It expects flagged stocks to do worse over the next 20 trading days.

forecasters.can_route: Yes: it can set an Avoid call.
forecasters.name: Big opening gaps up (warning flag)
forecasters.standing: Earned the top grade. 3 top-grade forms: one for names in the second fifth of trading activity over 20 days, one for calm days in that same fifth over 5 days, and one for fear days when the market sat above a rising 200-day average over 5 days.
forecasters.what: Flags a stock that opened at least 10% above its previous day's closing price. Its forms expect flagged stocks to do worse over the next 20 trading days, or the next 5, depending on the form.

forecasters.can_route: No: they never set a call. They are shown as a warning about risk only.
forecasters.name: How-much-prices-move forecasters
forecasters.standing: Earned the top grade in the study, as movement forecasts.
forecasters.what: 57 forecasters that say how much a price is likely to move, not which way: 48 built from past movement patterns, 7 from a share of trading measure, and 2 from options positioning.

forecasters.can_route: No: with no top-grade buy-side forecaster on the book, a Buy call, or a Hold call from evidence, cannot be given yet.

forecasters.standing: None reached the top grade in the book as recorded. The book holds 388 entries in total: 63 at the top grade and 325 one grade down, on probation.
forecasters.what: Forecasters that point up, toward buying.

forecasters.can_route: No: a forecaster on probation is never the reason for a call.

forecasters.what: 325 entries in the book that earned the second grade. They are kept in the book and shown when they match a name.

subject_charts.title: The names the router said to avoid, and why

rule.labels: For a name you do not own, the call can be Buy, Wait, or Avoid. For a name you own, it can be Hold, Trim, or Sell: Sell needs the careful lower end to stay above zero at the stricter 99% careful level too, otherwise the strongest exit call is Trim. Wait means the evidence supports a buy, or an exit, but a check against the plan already recorded for the name, or a stop switch, is holding it back.
names_a_forecaster_when: A forecaster in the book that earned the top grade matches the name on every part of the setting it was graded under, and that forecaster has a reading for the name today.
The day's trading is finished, the name's own trading cost is measured, and how much money trades in the name is measured and inside the range the forecaster was graded on.
The forecaster was scored on at least 30 dates in every stretch of time it was graded over.

After subtracting trading costs (both sides of a buy, one side of a sale, none for avoid or hold), the careful lower end of what following it would have gained per day, over doing the best other thing including doing nothing, is still above zero. The careful lower end allows for the fact that its graded days overlap, uses the 95% careful level, and takes the weakest of its graded stretches, so one good stretch cannot carry it.
rule.never_routes: Forecasters that only say how much a price may move never set a call; they are shown as a warning about risk only. Forecasters on probation, the second grade down, and any that were marked down are shown but never routed. Anything that fails, is missing, or cannot be checked means no call, with the reason recorded.
rule.one_name_one_call: One name gets one call: the passing forecaster with the strongest careful lower end speaks, and any others that pass are listed as support, never added together. If passing forecasters point both ways, that is a conflict and the answer is no call.
rule.watches: For each name, each day, it watches: whether the day's trading is finished (only a closed day counts); whether you own the name, do not own it, or that is not known (not known means no call); the day's setting (a fear day or a calm day, whether the market sits above its 200-day average and whether that average is rising, the fear gauge's reading, how actively the name trades compared with other names, the name's age and its trend state; any part of the setting that is not known never matches); each forecaster's reading for the name (a warning flag counts as on only when its reading is clearly on, and a score counts only when it sits in the top fifth or the bottom fifth of all scores that day, matching the direction the forecaster was graded on); what it costs to trade this name, measured for this name; how much money usually trades in the name; and any plan already recorded for the name.
rule.why_usually_no_call: That is why it usually says no call: every condition has to hold at once, most names match no top-grade forecaster on a given day, and on the book as recorded no buy-side forecaster reached the top grade at all, so a Buy call cannot be given from evidence yet. Avoid can be given, and Trim or Sell on a name you own.
